description: Evidence-based answers on the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) and the General Data Protection Regulation. Not legal advice.
epilog:
Examples:
  compliance-helper --lang en classify "We pre-sort job applications with a language model"
  compliance-helper --lang en ask "Do we need an impact assessment?" --role deployer
  compliance-helper --lang en search "Article 6(3)" --brief
  compliance-helper --lang en serve --port 8000
  compliance-helper --lang en status
  compliance-helper --lang en build-index --language en
help_help: show this help message and exit
help_no_color: no colour in the output (like NO_COLOR)
help_json: output as JSON, for further processing
help_lang: output language; default from COMPLIANCE_HELPER_LANG, otherwise de
help_classify: Classify a system, without a language model
help_system_description: The AI system in your own words
help_role: provider, deployer, importer, distributor, product_manufacturer, authorised_representative — may be repeated
help_legal_act: restrict the search to AI-Act, GDPR, BDSG or Guidelines
help_show_wording: also print the wording of the citations
help_reload: reload on source code changes (development only)
help_status: Shows what the tool works with
app_running: The AI Act Compliance Helper is running at {address}
check_no_executable:
No built program found. Searched in:
  {candidates}
check_page_without_flow: The start page answers but does not show the question flow.
check_flow_data_missing: The question data is missing or too small: {status}, {size} characters
check_passed: The package runs on port {port}, the question flow is there ({kilobytes} KB).
check_no_answer: The built program did not answer on any port.
help_verbose: also write the developer log to stderr
count_out_of_range: {value!r} is not a whole number from 1 to {maximum}
help_build_corpus: Build the legal corpus of one language from the raw texts
help_build_index: Build the search index of one language from its corpus
help_build_language: language of the corpus or search index: de or en (default de)
help_check: check and report only, write nothing
help_output_dir: write corpus and report here instead of data/processed
help_fallback: build without an embedding model (tests only)
help_from_scratch: embed every unit again: discard the stored index and checkpoints
data_missing: There are no rule files in {path}. The installed package brings them along; if the tool works with your own data, set {variable} to the folder that contains the data folder.
corpus_without_sources: There are no Official Journal texts in {path}; the corpus would consist of the use cases only and is not written. Fetch them first, in the source folder: {command}
corpus_warnings: {count} warnings during the build; --verbose shows them, and once written they are also in the report.
corpus_checked: Corpus ({language_name}) checked: {count} legal units, nothing written.
index_model_missing: The embedding model {model} is not available. A search index of fallback quality is not written. Install it: pip install 'ai-act-compliance-helper[search]'
index_written: Search index ({language_name}) saved: {count} legal units with {model} in {seconds} s, folder {path}
rules_unusable: The rule files in {path} are missing or damaged; without them no classification is possible. --verbose shows the details.
file_access: No access to {path}: read-only or without permission. The data builds need a writable folder; COMPLIANCE_HELPER_ROOT can point to a copy.
